```yaml
name: Extension Publish Marketplace

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/extension-publish-marketplace.yml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - '.github/prompts/**'
      - '.github/agents/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  validate-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1

      - name: Validate Markdown Linting
        run: npm run lint:md

      - name: Validate Spell Check
        run: npm run spell-check

      - name: Validate Frontmatter
        run: npm run lint:frontmatter

      - name: Validate Skill Structure
        run: npm run validate:skills

      - name: Validate Markdown Links
        run: npm run lint:md-links

      - name: Validate PowerShell Analysis
        run: npm run lint:ps

      - name: Generate Plugins
        run: npm run plugin:generate

      - name: Build Extension
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish to Marketplace
        run: npm run publish
        env:
          MARKETPLACE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MARKETPLACE_TOKEN }}
```
